name: linear-devotee
description: Linear orchestration for Codex with complete AC-traceable issue packets, exact verified dependency graphs, validated implementation plans, and explicit mutation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and create Linear work from Codex
interface.longDescription: Linear Devotee bundles Codex skills for detecting Linear issues, producing SDD briefs, setting work in progress, planning implementation with exhaustive AC coverage, recommending the next dependency-ready issue, and creating Linear project cascades. Complete issue bodies and a canonical dependency DAG go behind one approval, are replayed recoverably, then reloaded and compared before the project is marked verified. Linear writes stay behind explicit confirmation except the documented In Progress flip during greet.
defaultPrompt: Use Linear Devotee to brief this Linear issue before implementation.
Use Linear Devotee to create a project, milestones, and issues from this spec.
Use Linear Devotee to recommend the next issue after this one is done.
